LOCATIONS_DESCRIPTION: Edit default locations for common visit types.
PRINT_MESSAGE_HELP: This message will print at the bottom of the patient ticket. Leave blank to print no message.
PRINT_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: Message to print on the patient ticket
NAME: Name
PRINT_FORMAT_HELP: Select the default print format for patient tickets at this location.
TICKET_PRINTER_HOST_HELP: IP address of the ESC/POS thermal printer for this location in the format of an IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.100).
TICKET_PRINTER_PORT_HELP: TCP port of the thermal printer. Usually 9100.
PRINT_SERVER_HOST_HELP: The IP address or hostname of the computer running the local print server.
PRINT_SERVER_PORT_HELP: The TCP port used by the local print server. Normally 3333.
PRINT_SERVER_URL_PREVIEW: Print server URL used by the app:
TICKET_PRINTER_URL_PREVIEW: Ticket printer URL used by the app:
